title: Refund and Claims Rules for Ridgeline Orders & Delivery Orders
content:
## Refunds

Every refund on a Ridgeline Orders & Delivery order goes back to the tender of the order payment and references that payment. The refunds on an order never exceed what was paid, so a refund may not exceed the net amount paid on the order at the time it is issued.

**Net amount paid.** The total of the payments received on the order less the total of the refunds already issued on it, over the life of the order up to the current date.

*Worked example (hypothetical figures).* An order was paid $420.00 by bank card, and $150.00 has already been refunded on it. The net amount paid is $420.00 less $150.00, that is $270.00. A further refund of $270.00 or less is within the limit; a further refund of $300.00 would exceed it.

A refund made to a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account, or to Ridgeline Pro Credit, posts on that account as a return credit referencing the order number.

## Shipped orders reported not received

A shipped order reported not received is investigated when the report is made within the program's not-received reporting days after the promised date. Where the program records a photo at delivery as proof and the photo shows delivery to the address, the claim is declined; otherwise the order is reshipped or refunded.

| Investigated claim | Program records a photo at delivery | Photo shows delivery to the address | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Declined |
| Yes | Yes | No | Reshipped or refunded |
| Yes | No | Not applicable | Reshipped or refunded |

## Signature on delivery

Shipped orders above the program's signature threshold for shipped orders, and truck deliveries where the program requires an adult signature, are delivered only against an adult signature.
